bannerSynthetic: We are testing automatic processing with fictional dreams. Please do not send personal stories yet.
bannerPersonal: Tell us your dream and the service will prepare a reflection here.
bannerUnavailable: The processor is temporarily unavailable. Its status updates automatically.
bannerDisconnected: Automatic processing is not connected yet.
configError: We could not check service availability. Your draft is still here.
introBody: Images, feelings, and your own associations can open a calm reflection on what stayed with you.
introHelp: There are no universal symbol meanings or predictions here. You decide what resonates with your experience.
formDescription: Type or dictate it. You can always edit the text before sending it.
dreamPlaceholder: For example: I dreamed of a blue parrot…
syntheticConsent: I confirm that this is a fictional dream.
consent: I agree to send this text to Sonnic for processing in ChatGPT. The text and response are stored on the Sonnic server. Each new reflection uses a temporary chat without personalization; ChatGPT may retain a copy for up to 30 days. Deleting on this site does not delete ChatGPT copies or backup archives. Sonnic does not store audio.
submitUnavailable: Sending is temporarily unavailable: the reflection service is not connected to ChatGPT. Your text remains in this tab. The button will become available when the connection returns. You do not need to dictate again.
submitChecking: Checking reflection availability. You can prepare your text now; sending will become available once the service connects.
submitRecording: Finish or cancel dictation before sending your dream.
submitTooShort: Add at least {remaining} more characters. The minimum is 20; leading and trailing spaces do not count.
submitTooLong: Shorten your text to 10,000 characters before sending it.
submitConsent: Tick the consent box above the send button to allow text processing.
submitReady: Everything is ready. You can send your dream for reflection.
snapshotErrorFallback: Processing did not finish. Refresh the status or try again.
queuedBody: Your dream is waiting in the queue. Reflection will start automatically and appear here. Each job has an overall ten-minute limit.
leasedBody: The service is preparing your reflection. This page will update automatically.
deletedNotice: The active record containing the dream and result was deleted from the Sonnic server. This does not delete ChatGPT copies, earlier test chat history, or backup archives.
resultDisclaimer: This is one possible interpretation for self-reflection, not a prediction or diagnosis.

aboutSteps.title: Record what you remember
aboutSteps.body: Even a short scene is enough. You can add your feeling after waking separately.

aboutSteps.title: Get another perspective
aboutSteps.body: The service highlights details from your account and offers a careful interpretation. The response appears here.

aboutSteps.title: Find your connection
aboutSteps.body: The closing question helps you explore your own associations. There is no single correct interpretation.

faqs.question: How long does a response take?
faqs.answer: The wait depends on the story length, queue, and ChatGPT availability. Dreams are processed one at a time, and the response appears automatically. ChatGPT limits may temporarily pause processing. Each job has an overall ten-minute limit.

faqs.question: Where are the text and response stored?
faqs.answer: On the Sonnic server. Each new reflection uses a temporary ChatGPT chat without personalization, which is not added to history. ChatGPT may retain a copy for up to 30 days. Deleting on this site removes the active Sonnic record; it does not delete ChatGPT copies or backup archives. Earlier test chat history is removed separately. Please use fictional dreams only for now.

faqs.question: Why might voice input be unavailable?
faqs.answer: Recognition depends on your browser and microphone permission. If it is unavailable, type the text or use your device keyboard's dictation. Check recognized words before sending.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay?
faqs.answer: The short beta reflection is free. Payments and the deep reflection flow are not connected yet.

errorFallback: The action did not complete. Refresh the status and try again.

states.queued: Dream saved and waiting for reflection
states.leased: ChatGPT is reflecting on the dream
states.awaiting_review: A diagnostic response is waiting for operator review
states.failed: We could not complete the reflection

errors.worker_unavailable: The processor is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.synthetic_input_required: Only fictional dreams are accepted at this stage.
errors.deadline: The waiting time has expired. You can try processing again.
errors.page_changed: Processing is paused because the service needs attention.
errors.login_required: Processing is paused until the operator signs in to ChatGPT.
errors.model_limit: The service has reached its processing limit. Try again later.
errors.generation_timeout: The reflection was not completed in time. You can try again.
errors.invalid_model_output: The response failed format checks. You can try again.
errors.submission_uncertain: We could not confirm submission. Processing is paused for an operator check so the dream is not sent twice.
errors.session_required: Your session has ended. Start again.
errors.job_not_found: This entry is unavailable in the current browser.
errors.queue_full: The queue is temporarily full. Finish or delete the previous entry.
errors.connection_failed: Could not connect to the server. Try the action again.
errors.review_changed: The response changed. Refresh its status and check it again.
errors.retry_not_allowed: No more processing attempts are available.
errors.not_awaiting_review: This response has already been reviewed or is out of date.
errors.review_rejected: The reflection was rejected. You can start another attempt.
errors.lease_expired: ChatGPT did not return a response in time. You can try again.
errors.job_expired: The waiting period ended. You can try again.
errors.invalid_input: Check the dream text: it must contain 20 to 10,000 characters.
